Kathrin Petersen Thanks for the reply. They don't have his passport and we haven't quite started the process yet, as we don't have all of the required documents. So far I've only sent the requested proofs of the relationship, and we're waiting for a few documents from the German ministries.
I wouldn't want to separate from him and move on my own, especially while pregnant. If we apply for clearance, he can't enter as a tourist at all until it's approved? Any idea how long that might take?
